narrative.overview:
The website combines a technical library's precision with a working 3D studio's warm, dark surround. This describes the built world, not a new brand proposition: Vie Agentic Skill remains a Vietnamese-first, multi-agent runbook library. The pinned Blender Skills reference informs the charcoal/orange material language; it does not replace the identity or make the whole library a Blender product.

Expression comes from the actual credited Blender render, tightly spaced system headings, orange actions and readable ruled surfaces. Task controls stay familiar: native form elements, inline detail, clear prerequisites and compact metadata. Dark is the default; the light alternative preserves the same hierarchy and changes the palette by role. This root system covers the public website only, not the independent design instructions contained inside individual skills.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal surfaces with a restrained orange action hierarchy.
System sans for Vietnamese text; monospace reserved for commands and shortcuts.
Flat ruled lists, modest corners and tonal selection rather than floating panels.
Real credited imagery and visible source, license and prerequisite information.
Native disclosure, keyboard-visible states and responsive task controls.

rules.name: The Action Orange Rule
rules.body: Use orange for actions, links and selection; keep ordinary descriptions and provenance muted.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Switch the whole set of role values together, including action text, warning and selection colors.

rules.name: The Readable Density Rule
rules.body: Create compactness through hierarchy and grouping, not by compressing description line-height or clipping an expanded runbook's only full-text access.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary content flat; reserve drop shadows for the toast and manual-copy overlays.

dos: Do use the complete theme role set and the paired text color on orange actions.
Do preserve Vietnamese-first labels, system-font rendering and readable supporting text.
Do keep ruled list discovery and the optional grid consistent with the same selected state.
Do retain visible focus, native disclosure and the reduced-motion alternative.
Do keep the credited Blender render, VAS identity, provenance and explicit prerequisites.
Do let long commands, paths and runbook names wrap within responsive containers.
donts: Don't turn the orange action hierarchy into decorative full-surface color.
Don't add floating shadows to ordinary catalog rows, cards or settings.
Don't replace plain metadata with interactive-looking badges.
Don't substitute the reference site's identity for Vie Agentic Skill or imply every runbook operates Blender.
Don't present catalog risk metadata as a safety guarantee or hide requirements behind promotional copy.
Don't introduce movement that survives the existing reduced-motion preference.
